overviewHtml:
Bezika: Shopify Ecommerce Development for a Bilingual Online Store

Project Overview

Bezika is a Kuwait-focused home and lifestyle ecommerce store built on Shopify, designed to deliver a seamless online shopping experience for Arabic and English-speaking customers. The project combines modern storefront design, intuitive product discovery, and practical ecommerce functionality to create a consistent shopping experience across devices.

The Challenge

Creating an effective ecommerce storefront requires more than displaying products. Customers need to navigate collections easily, understand product offerings, discover promotions, and move through the shopping journey without unnecessary friction. For a bilingual store serving the Kuwaiti market, maintaining a consistent experience across Arabic and English adds another layer of consideration.

My Approach

I worked on Shopify storefront customization, focusing on product presentation, collection organization, responsive layouts, and the overall user experience. The goal was to create a cohesive storefront that reflects the brand's identity while making browsing and shopping straightforward.

Shopify Theme Customization

The storefront was tailored to the brand's requirements using Shopify's theme architecture and relevant frontend technologies. This involved working with Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize the presentation and functionality of the online store.

Bilingual Ecommerce Experience

The store supports Arabic and English, catering to different language preferences within its target market. The experience prioritizes clear navigation, consistent presentation, and usability across both language versions.

Product Discovery and Navigation

Product organization and collection navigation play an important role in helping customers explore a store. The storefront brings together product listings, collections, and promotional content to make browsing more intuitive.

Responsive Web Design

The storefront was developed with a focus on responsive presentation, helping customers browse the store across desktop and mobile devices while maintaining a consistent visual experience.

Technologies Used

  • Shopify: Ecommerce platform and storefront management

  • Liquid: Shopify theme templating and customization

  • JavaScript: Frontend interactions and functionality

  • HTML & CSS: Store structure, styling, and responsive layouts

Project Outcome

Bezika brings together Shopify development, ecommerce website customization, and bilingual storefront design in a cohesive online shopping experience. The project demonstrates my approach to building practical, brand-focused ecommerce websites that balance visual presentation with usability.

title: Tesoro
desc: A card-linked rewards platform for the gaming economy, built for speed with a game-first interface.
overview: Tesoro is a rewards platform built for the $125 billion gaming economy, connecting gamers, merchants, and game studios through a seamless card-linked loyalty system. The platform allows players to earn real rewards simply by spending on their everyday purchases, while merchants gain access to a highly engaged gaming audience. Studios benefit from deeper player retention through integrated incentive mechanics. Powered by Visa and Mastercard infrastructure, Tesoro bridges the gap between the physical retail world and digital gaming ecosystems, creating a frictionless rewards experience at scale.

title: Cord Studio
desc: An e-commerce storefront for contemporary clothing and premium leather goods, with bespoke monogramming.
overview: Cord Studio is an Indian contemporary fashion brand offering a curated range of clothing and premium leather goods. The brand blends modern design sensibilities with artisanal craftsmanship, releasing limited seasonal collections that celebrate quality and individuality. A standout feature of the brand is its personalised monogramming service, allowing customers to add a bespoke touch to their leather pieces. The e-commerce experience is crafted to reflect the brand's refined aesthetic, with clean layouts, editorial photography, and an intuitive shopping journey that makes luxury feel accessible and personal.

title: Black Fridye
desc: A campaign store for a sustainable clothing label, pairing provocative storytelling with a one-service checkout.
overview: Black Fridye is a sustainable fashion initiative by Citizen Wolf, launched as an annual event every November as an ethical counter to Black Friday consumerism. Instead of buying new, customers send in their faded or worn garments to be professionally re-dyed, giving their clothes a second life and dramatically reducing textile waste. The campaign-style website is bold, provocative, and purposefully minimal, using strong typography and a high-contrast palette to challenge fast fashion norms. The e-commerce flow is streamlined around a single service, making it easy for customers to understand the process, select their garment, and book a dye job in just a few clicks.

title: Avantgarde Artist Agency
desc: A booking and roster site for a London electronic music agency, built around bold, editorial layouts.
overview: Avantgarde Artist Agency is a London-based electronic music booking and management agency with over 20 years of experience in the industry. Representing more than 20 internationally acclaimed artists, the agency specialises in connecting world-class electronic music talent with promoters, festivals, and venues across the globe. The website reflects the agency's bold artistic identity, featuring a dark, immersive design with dynamic typography and a refined visual language that speaks directly to the underground music scene. The site serves as a central hub for artist discovery, tour booking, and brand communication.

title: Innovative Dental Springfield
desc: A calm, accessible site for a premium dental practice, built to drive bookings and patient confidence.
overview: Innovative Dental is a premium dental practice based in Springfield, Missouri, renowned for delivering a spa-like patient experience alongside world-class clinical care. The practice specialises in dental implants, orthodontics, and cosmetic dentistry, combining cutting-edge technology with a warm, welcoming environment that puts patient comfort first. The website was designed to communicate trust, expertise, and approachability, using clean white aesthetics and professional photography to ease patient anxiety and guide visitors through available treatments. Appointment booking and patient education are centralised for a seamless digital-to-clinic journey.
